actions.failFlow.description: Fails this step with your error message.
actions.failFlow.props.info.description: The run fails here and later steps do not run. If Add Error Handler is on, only this step fails. The Failure branch runs and the flow continues.
actions.failFlow.props.message.descripti: Shown as the step's error. Can include data from earlier steps.
actions.getRunId.description: Gets this run's ID and a link to open it.
actions.getRunId.props.info.description: Outputs this run's ID and a link that opens the run.
actions.stopFlow.description: Ends the run at this step and marks it as succeeded.
actions.stopFlow.props.info.description: The run ends here and is marked as succeeded. Steps after this one do not run.
description: Stop or fail a running flow, or get a link to the current run.
